Recall ceiling and recall at the threshold

Source: R/recall_ceiling.R
recall_ceiling.Rd

Estimates how much of the true activity of a species the classifier can recover. The occasions drawn with sampling_mode = "random_recordings" and annotated by ear say where the species called, whatever the classifier said; matched with the highest score of the species in each occasion (from the selection tables), they give:

Usage

recall_ceiling(
  validation,
  detections,
  thresholds = NULL,
  by = "species_folder",
  min_confidence = 0.1,
  occasion_unit = c("file", "minute"),
  remap_from = NULL,
  remap_to = NULL,
  threshold_column = "threshold",
  n_boot = 1000,
  cluster = "source_audio",
  conf = 0.95,
  seed = 2026
)

Arguments

validation

Reviewed clips (e.g. from read_validation_tables()), with the occasions of "random_recordings": site, species_code, occasion_id, sampling_mode, verdict ("positive" when the species was heard in the occasion, "negative" when not; other verdicts are left out), inclusion_prob and the cluster column. Clips of other designs are ignored.

detections

Predictions, as returned by read_selection_tables().

thresholds

Thresholds at which the recall is computed: a numeric vector (the same for every group), or a table with the by columns and a threshold column, such as the output of suggest_thresholds() (threshold_column picks another column, such as "threshold_conservative" of threshold_bootstrap()). NULL gives the ceiling only.

by

Columns that define the groups: "species_folder" (the default, every site pooled) or c("site", "species_folder").

min_confidence

The lowest score kept in the selection tables (the minimum confidence BirdNET was run with). Predictions below it are not counted.

occasion_unit

The occasion of the draw: "file" or "minute".

remap_from, remap_to

Remapping of the audio paths of detections, as in select_clips().

threshold_column

Column of thresholds with the threshold.

n_boot

Number of bootstrap replicates; 0 skips the intervals.

cluster

Column of validation whose levels are resampled whole: "source_audio" (the recording, the default) or "night".

conf

Probability of the intervals.

seed

Seed of the bootstrap. The global random number generator is left as it was.

Value

A tibble with one row per group (and threshold): the by columns, n_occasions (annotated occasions), n_present (occasions with the species), n_missed (occasions with the species and no prediction of it), recall_ceiling with ceiling_lower and ceiling_upper; with thresholds, also threshold, share_above, recall and recall_lower, recall_upper. Groups with no occasion with the species get NA.

Details

  • the recall ceiling: the share of the occasions with the species that have at least one prediction of it with a score of at least min_confidence. The species called in the other occasions, but the classifier gave it no score worth keeping, so no threshold recovers them;

  • the recall at a threshold t: the share of the occasions with the species whose highest score is at least t. It is the ceiling times the share of the detected occasions whose highest score reaches t (share_above).

Both are ratios weighted by 1 / inclusion_prob, so occasions drawn with different probabilities (a different fraction per site) count for the occasions they stand for. The intervals come from a bootstrap of whole recordings (cluster) within each group.

Reading it. A low ceiling means that the classifier misses the species altogether in many occasions with it: check whether a lower min_confidence recovers them without many false positives, and if not, the problem is the classifier, not the threshold. A high ceiling with a low recall at the threshold means that the threshold, not the classifier, loses the occasions; weigh it against the precision the threshold buys (suggest_thresholds(), threshold_bootstrap()).

What is needed. The occasion of the annotation and of the predictions must be the same: give the occasion_unit of the draw, and the remap_from / remap_to of the draw when the recordings moved. Few occasions with the species give wide intervals: the ceiling of a species seldom present needs many annotated occasions.

See also

select_clips() ("random_recordings"), suggest_thresholds(), threshold_bootstrap(), threshold_record().

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
det <- read_selection_tables("birdnet")
val <- read_validation_tables(files)
recall_ceiling(val, det, thresholds = c(0.5, 0.7, 0.9))

# at the threshold of each cell
thr <- suggest_thresholds(val, target_precision = 0.95)
recall_ceiling(val, det, thresholds = thr,
               by = c("site", "species_folder"))
} # }
